exposure: term gestational age of labor initiation
cohort: Nulliparous, term, singleton, and vertex-presenting women
finding: Women who underwent induction of labor had a statistically significant higher cesarean delivery rate compared to those with spontaneous labor at each gestational age.
mod_finding: No difference in neonatal morbidity, as measured by 5-minute Apgar score, was observed between induced and spontaneous labor groups.
